svg.desc: Five steps: choose the system on validation, write and hash a pre-registration, open the test week once, bootstrap by user, and report with the plan's hash. A dashed forbidden path goes from the test set back to choosing.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Open the test set once, under a plan written first

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pre-registration's hash goes into the results file, so anyone can check the order.
